_doc: Teller activity generator config — admin-editable. Drives the Teller Activity Generator (utils/teller_activity_generator.py) which simulates a quarter of operational activity per Teller and submits BSC actuals via the verified bsc_engine path. Edit this file to tune target levels, performance band distributions, and noise factors. Run `python scripts/generate_teller_activity.py --period 2026-Q2` after edits.

performance_bands._note: Distribution of Tellers across performance bands. Determined deterministically by hash(staff_code) so the same Teller always lands in the same band. Sum must equal 1.0.

kpi_targets._note: Target values per KPI. Teller's actual value is target × performance_factor + small noise. Higher-is-better KPIs scale up with factor; lower-is-better (none in this list) scale down.

CX Score.description: Customer experience score from post-interaction surveys

Staff Productivity.description: Composite staff productivity index — transactions/hour + accuracy + attendance

Audit Score.description: Audit compliance score — branch-level audit findings + Teller-level cash handling

K013.description: Branch Daily Log Completion — % of daily logs completed correctly

K014.description: AML/CFT Compliance Score — STR filings + KYC completeness + sanctions screening

K012.description: Digital Transactions (%) — % of total transactions migrated to digital channels

quarter_drift._note: Small quarter-over-quarter improvement trend (most Tellers improve slightly). Each subsequent quarter applies this multiplier to the base value (compounding).

band_movement._note: Quarter-over-quarter movement between bands. Most Tellers stay in their band; ~5% move up or down each quarter. Movement is deterministic by hash(staff_code, period_index).

_simulation_metadata._note: Internal — used by the generator for tagging submissions.

_validation_rules._note: Hardcoded — NOT admin-configurable. The generator enforces these regardless of config edits.
